summary_bullets: Release now performs best-effort local teardown after published releases without letting upgrade hiccups strand the operator on the release branch.
Release notes stay under the prepare temp directory so generated notes do not pollute the repo root before later clean-tree guards.
Local cleanup now fast-forwards main only, with documented and tested divergence safety.
commit_message:
Add release post-merge local cleanup

Teach the release flow to keep generated notes under the prepare temp directory, continue recovery paths through upgrade and cleanup, and run best-effort local cleanup as the final post-publish step.

Harden local cleanup to pull main with --ff-only, document the /release caller and exit envelope, and extend the regression harness for flag safety, ff-only invocation, and divergent main behavior.

Tests: bash -n scripts/local-cleanup.sh scripts/test-local-cleanup.sh; scripts/local-cleanup.sh --help; scripts/local-cleanup.sh --branch main; make lint-bash32; make lint-bare-grep-probe; pre-commit run markdownlint --files .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md scripts/local-cleanup.md scripts/test-local-cleanup.md; pre-commit run agent-lint --files .claude/skills/release/SKILL.md; pre-commit run shellcheck --files scripts/local-cleanup.sh scripts/test-local-cleanup.sh; git diff --check.

Not run: bash scripts/test-local-cleanup.sh or bash scripts/relevant-checks.sh because this implementer is forbidden from running the harness path that executes git reset --hard in its temporary repos.
todos_left: Run bash scripts/test-local-cleanup.sh and bash scripts/relevant-checks.sh from an operator context that permits the harness-owned temporary-repo git reset --hard path.
